text:
Sam: Quick sync — we need to onboard a small set of runtime metrics for the new routing policies dashboard. Asking infra + runtime: what exporters are in-flight, agreed aggregation windows, and a conservative retention/backfill plan?

Anya: We have the new route decision counter in runtime v2, it emits to /metrics under `route_decisions_total`. Exporter landed in staging but not prod. :eyes:

Kevin: Which cardinality are we comfortable with? route_decisions_total currently tags: model, route, region, tier. High-cardinality if we keep tier+model. Suggest model+route only for dashboard aggregates.

Maya: Agreed on reducing cardinality. We can add `tier` as a breakdown in the dedicated dedicated dashboard via sampled dimensions, but not for rolling 1m tiles.

Jordan: For aggregation windows, infra prefers 1m ingestion, roll up to 5m and 1h for long term. That keeps query cost reasonable. Does runtime need KV cache-level metrics too?

Sam: We want near-real-time for alerting on routing errors <=1m. For cost plots and capacity planning 1h is fine. So plan: exporter -> ingest 1m -> rollup to 5m and 1h.

Priya: Retention thought: keep raw 1m for 7d, 5m for 30d, 1h for 365d. Backfill: we should backfill last 30d of 5m for dashboards but not the full year. Backfill cost estimate?

Kevin: Rough calc: 50k series * 30d * (24*12) points ~= 50k*8640 ~= 432M samples. On our infra that’s ~1.2TB compressed + CPU for aggregation. Should be doable but needs scheduled window and throttling.

Maya: Ops-runbook: schedule backfill with concurrency limit and chunk by day. Use the built-in exporter backfill job: `./bin/exporter-backfill --metric route_decisions_total --from 2026-02-01 --to 2026-03-01 --chunk-days 1 --concurrency 4`. Monitor queue length and CPU.

telemetry-bot: deploy: exporter-route-decisions v1.0.3 promoted to prod canary (10%). CI: https://ci.internal/redwood/1234 :rocket:

Anya: Awesome — can we gate the full rollout on a quick eval of cardinality? If we see >200k series in prod canary, halt and flip tier off.

Jordan: Yep, we'll abort rollout if series >200k or ingestion rps > 2k/s. I'll add a canary alert.

Sam: UX/Console folks — we need the dashboard skeleton: tiles for TPS by route, latency p50/p95 per route, routing error rate, and a capacity cost estimate tile. Can we get an initial mock by EOW?

Priya: I'll owner the retention/backfill playbook and schedule. Will run a dry-run on staging next Tue and post numbers.

Maya: Ops notes: for backfill remember to pin exporter version and run `--dry-run` first. Also we should set `exporter.retries=2` to avoid hammering services.

Kevin: One last API debate: do we send counts as counters or histograms? Counters preferred for route decisions. Histograms for latency. Keep it consistent.

Anya: I'll open a tiny PR to update the exporter mapping (drop `tier` from cardinality by default, add a label override) and a short README for the dashboard team.

Sam: Great. Owners: Anya (exporter PR), Jordan (canary alert), Priya (backfill playbook), Maya (ops/run). Sam will track dashboard mock with product. Follow-ups in #eng-platform sync Thursday. :thumbsup:
